defines quality gates and testing schedule for all phases Download ExcelDownload PDF **36** Checkpoints **8** Sections Once per project section; updated if scope/schedule changes significantly QC Engineer, Project Manager [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) Related [📐SP 20](https://infralens.in/code/SP-20) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-cover) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧RCC design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1. SUBGRADE & EARTHWORK INSPECTION | | 1.1 | Subgrade excavation complete; profile matches design ±50mm
Acceptance: Profile survey at 100m intervals; visual inspection; photographic record; inspector witness required | Cl. 401 — Excavation completion | | | 1.2 | Subgrade compaction: Density ≥95% MDD achieved at 5 locations per km
Acceptance: Core/sand replacement tests; CBR ≥2%; hold point until approved; re-compaction if failed | Cl. 401 — Compaction verification | | | 1.3 | Subgrade approval: Formal sign-off issued; layer ready for base course placement
Acceptance: Completion certificate signed by QC engineer; all tests passed; conditions noted; witness point | Cl. 401 — Approval gate | | | 2. BASE COURSE (WBM/WMM/GSB) INSPECTION | | 2.1 | Base course material: Aggregate source approved; test certs (LA, impact, grading) available
Acceptance: Source audit; test certificates <12 months old; witness point for first load acceptance | Cl. 401 — Material approval | | | 2.2 | Material spreading: Layer thickness 150-200mm; uniform distribution; no segregation
Acceptance: Thickness checks at 50m intervals; visual inspection; witness point for 1st 500m; photo record | Cl. 401 — Layer control | | | 2.3 | Base course compaction: Density ≥98% SP (WBM/WMM) or ≥95% SP (GSB); 1 test per 250m²
Acceptance: Core cutter tests; hold point until density approved; 95% pass rate minimum; re-compact sections Acceptance: Lab CBR test; result recorded; affects bituminous layer thickness; hold point for design approval | Cl. 401 — Bearing capacity | | | 2.5 | Base course approval: Completion certificate issued; all tests passed; ready for bituminous overlay
Acceptance: Written approval from QC engineer; dated; signed; witness point for handover to paving crew | Cl. 401 — Phase approval | | | 3. MIX DESIGN & PLANT SETUP | | 3.1 | Mix design submitted: JMF, Marshall test, trial batch results, QA plan
Acceptance: JMF approved by engineer; Marshall stability ≥1800 kg, flow 2-4 mm, VIM 3-5%; hold point before production | Cl. 503 — Design submission | | | 3.2 | Batch plant calibration: Scales certified ±2%; temperature control verified; documentation available
Acceptance: Scale cert current; hot bin temps recorded; plant warm-up log; witness point for plant inspection | Cl. 503 — Equipment qualification | | | 3.3 | Bitumen approval: Grade, penetration, softening point, ductility tests passed
Acceptance: Test certs reviewed; grade confirmed; hold point until approved; first truck witnessed at plant | Cl. 501 — Binder approval | | | 3.4 | Paver & roller inspection: Equipment certified; operators trained; trial laying on test strip
Acceptance: Equipment inspection checklist; maintenance records; operator certs; 100m trial strip reviewed | Cl. 503 — Equipment readiness | | Showing 12 of 36 checkpoints ·View all → 1.
